messages:
Opsbot: INCIDENT ALERT · 3167890123 - High error rate detected for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (5xx spike)
Ellie: I got the page, I'm on it. checking logs and metrics now.
Samir: I'm standby as secondary — can take infra checks if needed.
Kai: I can help with security signals if we need to check auth patterns.
Ellie: quick status: 5xxs from gateway -> runtime backend returning 502/503. Correlating with KV cache misses.
Maria: support heads-up: a few enterprise tenants are seeing failures, incubator-prod and partner-abc. Not a wide blast yet.
Ellie: handoff note: I'll be AFK for ~10m at 3167890500 for a quick break, can Samir be primary while I'm out?
Samir: I can take primary at 3167890500. I'll own coordination until you return or I hand off.
Samir: routing q: who should be paged for the cache OOMs vs node saturation — runtime or infra?
Ellie: runtime owns model-serving layer (batcher, kv-cache, model pods) and app logs. infra owns nodepool, k8s autoscaling, LB. security handles auth/threat checks. support handles customer comms.
Tyler: runbook pointer: https://internal/runbooks/paging/oncall-handovers — follow section B for cross-team routing.
Samir: doing quick infra checks: `kubectl top nodes | sort -k3 -n` shows node-07 at 98% CPU, node-03 at 91%. HPA hasn't added pods yet.
Maria: LB logs show 5xx start 07:12 UTC, about +200 rps on model route. Error body has `upstream error: recv() failed`
Ellie: runtime logs show `KVCacheMiss` spike and repeated GC/oom-kill warn for model-worker-5. Possibly memory pressure leading to failed responses.
Kai: security note: seeing burst of failed token validations from IP 34.89.120.45 — looks like a noisy client, not necessarily malicious but could amplify load. recommend temporary throttle.
Samir: mitigation plan proposal: 1) scale runtime replicas + nodepool; 2) add rate-limit for noisy IP via WAF; 3) restart affected pods in rolling fashion. Any objections?
Ellie: agree. runtime should bump replicas and check memory limits; infra should prepare nodepool scale if HPA doesn't recover in 5m. Security to add IP denylist throttle.
Opsbot: @runtime-oncall paged (PD-4521). @infra-oncall paged (PD-4522). @security-oncall paged (PD-4523).
Maria: support: drafting message for customers: "We're investigating elevated error rates for text generation in us-west-2; working on mitigation. ETA 15-30m." Any additions?
Tyler: also update status page with the same short blurb and region. I can post it now.
Samir: runtime: please run `kubectl scale deployment/runtime-model --replicas=12 -n prod` and confirm pod join times. Then monitor 5xx rate.
Ellie: runtime action item: look at pod memory requests/limits — if OOMs are happening bump requests or change GC settings temporarily. Add metric alert for OOM_KILL.
Kai: security will add WAF rule for that IP and check if token failures are legitimate client retries. We'll post forensic logs to the incident channel.
Maria: sending draft to customers in 2m. I'll include impacted tenant list and link to status page.
Samir: taking over primary officially at 3167890500. I'll put checkpoints every 10 minutes or on major state change.
Tyler: posted status page update. :thumbsup:
Ellie: thanks. I'll be offline 3167890550-3167891199; if things degrade escalate to eng-oncall lead @oncall-lead.
Samir: acknowledged. I'll coordinate with runtime/infra/security/support. If they disagree on next steps, I'll call an immediate cross-team huddle.
Maria: noted — will keep customer comms queued and update once we have ETA.
Samir: will close this thread when resolved and attach timeline + links to logs and RCA steps.
